lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters. The central row contains the most distinct spots, spaced at regular intervals approximately 2-3 diameters apart.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, forming a visible grid-like arrangement of high-luminance nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges run along the upper third of the flank, each showing a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light superior edge and a dark inferior shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, circular local maxima visible within the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily located near the base and posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high-frequency distribution of small, high-luminance spots across its entire dorsal surface, exhibiting higher density than the flank pattern.
